title: Deployment & CI/CD
description: Ship your app to the world — hosting, pipelines, and automated deployments.
body:
## What is it?

**Deployment** is putting your application on a server so users on the internet can access it.

**CI/CD** (Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment) automates this process:
- **CI**: Automatically run tests when you push code
- **CD**: Automatically deploy when tests pass

## Hosting options

| Platform | Best for | Free tier |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| Vercel | Next.js, static sites | Yes |
| Cloudflare Pages | Static sites, edge | Yes |
| Railway | Full stack + DB | Limited |
| Fly.io | Docker containers | Limited |
| AWS / GCP | Enterprise | Minimal |

## CI/CD with GitHub Actions

```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
name: Deploy
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: '20' }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test
```

## Key concepts

- Environment variables: Keep secrets out of code
- `npm ci` vs `npm install` — `ci` is faster and more reliable for automation
- Build process: `npm run build` → static files
